"""Method-gated, prepared-only center signal equivalence; no new account evaluation."""

ROOT = next(p for p in HERE.parents if (p / "research/S013/experiments").is_dir())

NEW_MECHANISM = "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_CLOSE_ACF_RECOVERY"

EXIT_FIELDS = {
    "last_exit_reason": frozenset(("loss", "trailing", "range", "time", "regime")),
    "last_exit_route": frozenset(("bull", "bear")),
    "last_exit_category": frozenset(("BELOW", "EQUAL", "ABOVE")),

def digest(path):
    return sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read_json(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text("utf-8-sig"))


def standard(value):
    """No general missing/NaN cleanup: nullable metadata is explicitly None."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): standard(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [standard(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, (pd.Timestamp, np.datetime64)):
        assert not pd.isna(value)
        return pd.Timestamp(value).isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, np.generic):
        return standard(value.item())
    if isinstance(value, float):
        assert np.isfinite(value), "Nonfinite number cannot be retained"
    if value is pd.NA or value is pd.NaT:
        raise AssertionError("Missing value must be explicit None")
    return value


def write_json(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    assert not path.exists(), "Never overwrite prior proof/result"
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(standard(value), indent=2, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n", "utf-8"
    )


def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def pure_induction(frame, p):
    """Own common-state recurrence, not a financial or order replay.

    The old BODY recovery can differ from dual recovery only at original ACF
    failure with range/momentum/context/body eligibility. Require Close-up at
    EVERY such day, before score, and reconstruct both equal next states.
    """
    assert p["mechanism"] == OLD_MECHANISM
    assert p["context"] == {
        "entry_gate": "all",
        "volume_basis": "ADJUSTED",
        "weighting": "EQUAL_BLOCKS",
    }
    c = p["confirmation"]
    assert c["enabled"] and c["scope"] == "both"
    assert all(p[r]["cooldown"] == 0 for r in ("bull", "bear"))
    assert frame.index.is_unique and frame.index.is_monotonic_increasing and len(frame)
    holding, active, age, anchor, peak, last, last_route, category = (
        False,
        None,
        0,
        None,
        None,
        None,
        None,
        None,
    )
    records, recovery = [], []
    for i, row in enumerate(frame.itertuples()):
        for field in (
            "close",
            "entry_signal_close",
            "entry_signal_open",
            "previous_signal_close",
            "acf1",
            "momentum20",
            "confirmation_score",
            "bull_range_position",
            "bear_range_position",
        ):
            assert np.isfinite(getattr(row, field)), field
        assert (
            row.close == row.entry_signal_close > 0
            and row.entry_signal_open > 0
            and row.previous_signal_close > 0
        )
        assert row.regime in ("bull", "bear")
        assert (row.last_exit_reason, row.last_exit_route, row.last_exit_category) == (
            last,
            last_route,
            category,
        )
        route = active if holding else row.regime
        rp = p[route]
        position = getattr(row, route + "_range_position")
        before = (
            holding,
            active,
            age if holding else 0,
            anchor if holding else None,
            peak if holding else None,
            last,
            last_route,
            category,
        )
        acf_pass = rp["acf_min"] is None or row.acf1 >= rp["acf_min"]
        range_pass = position <= rp["entry"]
        momentum_pass = rp["momentum_min"] is None or row.momentum20 >= rp["momentum_min"]
        body = row.entry_signal_close > row.entry_signal_open
        close_up = row.entry_signal_close > row.previous_signal_close
        context = (
            not holding
            and row.regime == "bear"
            and last == "time"
            and last_route == "bear"
            and category == "BELOW"
        )
        old_recovery = bool(range_pass and momentum_pass and not acf_pass and context and body)
        new_recovery = bool(old_recovery and close_up)
        assert not old_recovery or close_up, (
            "Old recovery day lacks strict Close-up: equivalence theorem inapplicable"
        )
        old_eligible = bool(range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or context and body))
        new_eligible = bool(
            range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or context and body and close_up)
        )
        assert old_eligible == new_eligible and old_recovery == new_recovery
        score_pass = row.confirmation_score >= c["threshold"]
        opportunity = not holding and old_eligible
        assert bool(row.entry_acf_pass) == bool(acf_pass)
        assert row.entry_acf_value == row.acf1
        assert bool(row.entry_acf_recovery_applies) == old_recovery
        assert bool(row.entry_eligible) == old_eligible
        assert bool(row.confirmation_opportunity) == opportunity
        assert bool(row.confirmation_pass) == score_pass
        assert bool(row.entry_direction_up) == body
        assert not row.entry_direction_gate_applies
        assert row.confirmation_exit_context == (last or "initial")
        reason = "flat"
        if holding:
            age += 1
            peak = max(peak, row.close)
            loss = rp["stop_loss"] is not None and row.close / anchor - 1 <= -rp["stop_loss"]
            trail = rp["trailing_stop"] is not None and row.close / peak - 1 <= -rp["trailing_stop"]
            reason = (
                "loss"
                if loss
                else "trailing"
                if trail
                else "range"
                if position >= rp["exit"]
                else "time"
                if age >= rp["max_hold"]
                else "regime"
                if p["exit_on_regime_change"] and row.regime != active
                else "hold"
            )
            if reason != "hold":
                category = (
                    ("BELOW" if row.close < anchor else "ABOVE" if row.close > anchor else "EQUAL")
                    if reason == "time" and active == "bear"
                    else None
                )
                holding, last, last_route, active = False, reason, active, None
        elif old_eligible:
            reason = "entry" if score_pass else "confirmation_rejected"
            if score_pass:
                holding, active, age, anchor, peak = True, row.regime, 0, row.close, row.close
                last = last_route = category = None
        assert reason == row.signal_reason and float(holding) == row.target_position
        after = (
            holding,
            active,
            age if holding else 0,
            anchor if holding else None,
            peak if holding else None,
            last,
            last_route,
            category,
        )
        record = {
            "index": i,
            "signal_date": frame.index[i],
            "raw_route": row.regime,
            "before": before,
            "after": after,
            "old_eligible": old_eligible,
            "new_eligible": new_eligible,
            "old_recovery": old_recovery,
            "new_recovery": new_recovery,
            "score_pass": bool(score_pass),
            "body_up": bool(body),
            "close_up": bool(close_up),
            "signal_reason": reason,
            "target": float(holding),
            "entry_signal_close": row.entry_signal_close,
            "entry_signal_open": row.entry_signal_open,
            "previous_signal_close": row.previous_signal_close,
        }
        records.append(record)
        if old_recovery:
            recovery.append(record)
    groups = []
    years = sorted(set(frame.index.year))
    for year in ("ALL", *map(str, years)):
        for route in ("bull", "bear"):
            rows = [
                r
                for r in records
                if (year == "ALL" or str(r["signal_date"].year) == year) and r["raw_route"] == route
            ]
            rec = [r for r in rows if r["old_recovery"]]
            groups.append(
                {
                    "signal_year": year,
                    "raw_route": route,
                    "signal_days": len(rows),
                    "recovery_opportunities": len(rec),
                    "recovery_entries": sum(r["signal_reason"] == "entry" for r in rec),
                    "recovery_score_rejections": sum(
                        r["signal_reason"] == "confirmation_rejected" for r in rec
                    ),
                }
            )
    assert sum(r["signal_days"] for r in groups if r["signal_year"] == "ALL") == len(frame)
    assert sum(r["signal_days"] for r in groups if r["signal_year"] != "ALL") == len(frame)
    return {
        "status": "PASS",
        "all_days": records,
        "recovery_events": recovery,
        "groups": groups,
        "all_recovery_close_up": True,
        "same_state_induction_days": len(records),
        "terminal_common_state": records[-1]["after"],
    }


def canonical_exit_metadata(frame):
    """Only three nullable storage columns; reject counterfeit non-null meanings."""
    assert frame.columns.is_unique and set(EXIT_FIELDS).issubset(frame.columns)
    output, audit = frame.copy(), {}
    for name, allowed in EXIT_FIELDS.items():
        values = []
        for value in frame[name].to_numpy():
            if (
                value is None
                or value is pd.NA
                or (isinstance(value, (float, np.floating)) and np.isnan(value))
            ):
                values.append(None)
            else:
                assert isinstance(value, str) and value in allowed, (name, value)
                values.append(value)
        output[name] = pd.Series(values, index=frame.index, dtype=object)
        audit[name] = {
            "original_dtype": str(frame[name].dtype),
            "canonical_dtype": "object",
            "semantic_null_count": values.count(None),
        }
    for reason, route, category in output.loc[:, list(EXIT_FIELDS)].itertuples(
        index=False, name=None
    ):
        assert (reason is None) == (route is None)
        if reason == "time" and route == "bear":
            assert category in EXIT_FIELDS["last_exit_category"]
        else:
            assert category is None
    return output, audit


def public_action_audit(native, new_signals):
    """Existing public BUY/SELL/HOLD encoding, never execute an order."""
    assert "action" in native and native.action.isin(("BUY", "SELL", "HOLD")).all()
    assert len(native) == len(new_signals) and len(native)
    computed = []
    for frame in (native, new_signals):
        values = frame.target_position.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        assert np.isfinite(values).all() and np.isin(values, (0.0, 1.0)).all()
        previous = np.r_[0.0, values[:-1]]
        computed.append(
            np.where(values > previous, "BUY", np.where(values < previous, "SELL", "HOLD"))
        )
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(native.action.to_numpy(), computed[0])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(computed[0], computed[1])
    return {
        "status": "PASS",
        "encoding": "Strict target-change BUY/SELL/otherwise HOLD; signal only",
        "counts": {
            action: int(np.count_nonzero(computed[0] == action))
            for action in ("BUY", "SELL", "HOLD")
        },
    }


def compare_histories(old, new):
    pd.testing.assert_index_equal(old.index, new.index, exact=True)
    assert list(old.columns) == list(new.columns), (
        "Only declared diagnostic change allowed, no missing fields"
    )
    old, old_null_audit = canonical_exit_metadata(old)
    new, new_null_audit = canonical_exit_metadata(new)
    compared = [c for c in old if c != "entry_direction_up"]
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old[compared], new[compared], check_exact=True)
    assert np.array_equal(old.entry_direction_up, old.entry_signal_close.gt(old.entry_signal_open))
    assert np.array_equal(
        new.entry_direction_up,
        new.entry_signal_close.gt(new.entry_signal_open)
        & new.entry_signal_close.gt(new.previous_signal_close),
    )
    assert not (
        old.entry_acf_recovery_applies & old.entry_direction_up.ne(new.entry_direction_up)
    ).any()
    return {
        "status": "EXACT_SIGNAL_EQUIVALENCE",
        "signal_days": len(old),
        "exact_fields": compared,
        "allowed_diagnostic_fields": ["entry_direction_up"],
        "diagnostic_different_days": int(old.entry_direction_up.ne(new.entry_direction_up).sum()),
        "target_different_days": 0,
        "reason_different_days": 0,
        "nullable_storage_correction_only": {
            "fields": list(EXIT_FIELDS),
            "old": old_null_audit,
            "new": new_null_audit,
            "all_other_dtype_value_checks": "EXACT_UNCHANGED",
        },
    }


def authenticate_hashes(method):
    for group in ("source_files", "metadata_inputs"):
        for relative, expected in method[group].items():
            assert digest(ROOT / relative) == expected, relative


def authenticate_failure_chain(method=None):
    from czsc_trader.research_tools.evidence import EvidenceRef

    references, documents = [], []
    for relative in (V1_REF, FAILURE_REF):
        ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(read_json(ROOT / relative))
        assert (
            ref.experiment.strategy_id == "S013"
            and ref.experiment.experiment_id == "EX056_20261011"
        )
        assert digest(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
        references.append(ref.to_dict())
        documents.append(read_json(ref.resolve(ROOT)))
    prior, failure = documents
    assert prior == read_json(V1 / "method_draft.json")
    authenticate_hashes(prior)
    assert failure["status"] == "FAILED" and failure["result_pass_file_exists"] is False
    assert failure["actual_tool_result"]["exit_code"] == 1
    assert failure["phase"] == "compare_histories(old_model, dual)"
    assert failure["method_reference"] == references[0]
    assert failure["source_sha256"] == digest(V1 / "equivalence.py")
    assert failure["source"] == (V1 / "equivalence.py").read_text("utf-8")
    if method is not None:
        assert method["failed_v1_method_reference"] == references[0]
        assert method["failed_v1_execution_reference"] == references[1]
        assert method["failed_v1_source_sha256"] == failure["source_sha256"]
        assert method["prior_v1_method_document"] == prior
        assert method["prior_v1_failure_document"] == failure
    return references, documents


def method_guard(path):
    """Public exact method retention is checked before loading old cache or data."""
    from czsc_trader.research_tools.evidence import EvidenceRef

    method = read_json(path)
    authenticate_hashes(method)
    ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(read_json(ROOT / method["public_method_reference_path"]))
    assert ref.experiment.strategy_id == "S013" and ref.experiment.experiment_id == "EX056_20261011"
    assert digest(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
    assert read_json(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == method
    authenticate_failure_chain(method)
    return method, ref

def main(method_path):
    # All actual cache/financial bytes are below this public-retention guard.
    method, method_ref = method_guard(method_path)
    from dataflows import canonical_frame_sha256
    from strategy_runtime import (
        ParameterSet,
        StrategyCandidate,
        canonical_sha256,
        implementation_sha256,
    )
    from czsc_trader.research_tools.evidence import EvidenceRef
    from czsc_trader.research_tools.evaluation import (
        serialize_evaluation_evidence,
        validate_evaluation_evidence,
    )

    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
    sys.path.insert(0, str(OLD_SRC))
    common = load("common", OLD_SRC / "common.py")
    old_oracle = load("_ex056_equivalence_old55", OLD_SRC / "raw_recovery_oracle.py")
    new_oracle = load("_ex056_equivalence_independent", NEW_ORACLE)
    ctx = common.context(1)
    plan = read_json(OLD_PROTOCOLS / "plan.json")
    cfg = next(c for c in plan["configurations"] if c["label"] == "N0")
    assert cfg["candidate_id"] == "C7980" and cfg["mechanism"] == OLD_MECHANISM
    bound, result = common.cache_read(common.CACHE / "N0.pkl.gz")
    ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(method["old_center"]["account_reference"])
    assert ref.to_dict() == read_json(OLD_RUNS / "account_references.json")["N0"]
    assert ref.experiment.strategy_id == "S013" and ref.experiment.experiment_id == "EX055_20261011"
    assert digest(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
    formal = read_json(ref.resolve(ROOT))
    validate_evaluation_evidence(formal)
    assert serialize_evaluation_evidence(bound, result) == formal
    assert len(result.runs) == 1 and bound.strategy.candidate_id == "C7980"
    assert canonical_sha256(bound.strategy.payload) == canonical_sha256(cfg["payload"])
    assert tuple(bound.dependencies) == common.DEPENDENCIES
    identity = ctx.runtime.identify(bound.strategy, dependencies=bound.dependencies)
    assert (
        identity.content_sha256 == cfg["content_sha256"] == result.runs[0].identity.content_sha256
    )
    assert identity.source_sha256 == cfg["payload"]["runtime"]["source_sha256"]
    precheck = read_json(OLD_RUNS / "precheck.json")
    original_summary = read_json(OLD_RUNS / "analysis.json")["rows"]["N0"]
    assert (
        result.request_hash == original_summary["request_hash"]
        and result.result_hash == original_summary["result_hash"]
    )
    assert (
        precheck["status"] == "PASS"
        and precheck["configuration"] == "N0"
        and precheck["result_hash"] == result.result_hash
        and precheck["provider_calls"] == []
    )
    native = result.runs[0].execution.decisions
    old_audit = old_oracle.audit_raw_recovery(ctx, bound, native, cfg["payload"]["parameters"])
    assert old_audit["status"] == "PASS" and not common.SOURCE_CALLS
    binding = next(iter(bound.input_bindings.values()))
    assert binding.prepared is not None
    request = binding.plan.requests["daily"]
    fetched = ctx.data.fetch(request, prepared=binding.prepared)
    assert fetched.ready and not common.SOURCE_CALLS
    assert canonical_frame_sha256(fetched.dataframe) == fetched.identity.content_sha256
    assert (
        fetched.identity.dataset == str(request.dataset)
        and fetched.identity.symbol == request.symbol == "510500.SH"
    )
    bars = fetched.dataframe.copy()
    bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
    dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(native.signal_date)).normalize()
    assert (
        bars.index.is_unique and bars.index.is_monotonic_increasing and dates.isin(bars.index).all()
    )
    assert bars.index[-1] == dates[-1]
    old_parameters = deepcopy(cfg["payload"]["parameters"])
    new_parameters = {**deepcopy(old_parameters), "mechanism": NEW_MECHANISM}
    new_payload = {
        "parameters": new_parameters,
        "runtime": {
            "contract_version": 1,
            "module": "strategy_runtime.strategies.bear_time_below_dual_recovery_range",
            "qualname": "BearTimeBelowDualRecoveryRange",
            "source_files": sorted(
                p.relative_to(NEW_SOURCE).as_posix() for p in NEW_SOURCE.rglob("*.py")
            ),
        },
    }
    new_payload["runtime"]["source_sha256"] = implementation_sha256(
        new_payload["runtime"]["source_files"], source_root=NEW_SOURCE
